item.title: BLACK CAT: Kaare Andrews Covers Featuring Mary Jane Team-Up Are The Christmas Gift You Didn't Know You Needed
item.description: Check out Kaare Andrews' connecting variant covers for Black Cat #7 and #8, a new arc in G. Willow Wilson and Gleb Melnikov's hit run that guest stars Mary Jane Watson, a.k.a. the All-New Venom.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Third Teaser Trailer Will Feature [SPOILER], [SPOILER], And [SPOILER]
item.description: New details about the third Avengers: Doomsday teaser trailer have been released, revealing which members of the X-Men we'll finally get to see in the MCU.

item.title: THE FANTASTIC FOUR: FIRST STEPS Concept Art Appears To Use Jodie Comer's Likeness For MCU's Sue Storm
item.description: Newly revealed concept art from The Fantastic Four: First Steps is receiving a lot of attention on social media for seemingly using Jodie Comer's likeness as Sue Storm/Invisible Woman.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Thor Teaser Trailer Leaks In English; Robert Downey Jr. Posts Iron Man/Doom Christmas Card
item.description: The Thor teaser trailer for Avengers: Doomsday is now available in English, and it's nothing short of epic. Robert Downey Jr., meanwhile, is celebrating the holidays with a Doctor Doom/Iron Man mashup.

item.title: Zack Snyder Posts Glorious Full-Body Images Of Henry Cavill Wearing Christopher Reeve’s SUPERMAN Suit
item.description: Zack Snyder has posted incredible colored images of Man of Steel star Henry Cavill wearing Christopher Reeve’s original Superman suit.

item.title: RUMOR: BARBIE Star Emma Mackey Is Being Eyed For A Role In Marvel Studios' X-MEN Reboot
item.description: According to a new rumour, Barbie star Emma Mackey is the latest actress to be on Marvel Studios' radar for the upcoming X-Men reboot helmed by Jake Schreier.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Suggests There Will Be A Traitor Among The Avengers, And We Know Who It Could Be
item.description: A new rumor suggests Avengers: Doomsday will feature a traitor among Earth’s Mightiest Heroes, and if true, we know who it could be.

item.title: 2025's Marvel Studios And DC Studios Superhero Live-Action Movies & TV Shows Ranked From Worst To Best
item.description: It's been a mixed bag for Marvel and DC movies and TV shows in 2025, and with 2026 now fast approaching, we're ranking all of the live-action projects from both studios.

item.title: After Nearly 20 Years, Marvel May Finally Allow Spider-Man To Get Back Together With Mary Jane For Good
item.description: After almost two decades since Peter Parker and Mary Jane sold their marriage to Mephisto, the two characters may finally be allowed to get back together in a meaningful way.
